issue.body:
# What

Adds JSON dumps of discussions on
- GitHub (various repos)
- discourse.nixos.org
- matrix
- the pad (technically a small subset of discourse, but whatever)

Adds docs and machinery.
4 MB.

# Why

Having all design inputs in one place is very useful. Greppable and all.
It's not a replacement for actual design guidelines or anything, but it's useful input that could perhaps substantiate those.

# How

Built with like a dozen prompts. Should be self-documenting etc.
I have not tested the GHA auto updating functionality.
To update matrix you'd have to provide a `MATRIX_TOKEN`. (probably want a separate account for that purpose)

# Really?

Not sure if we want to merge this into main. Maybe a separate branch or separate repo is better.
issue.title: Add data dump of most design discussions
